text:
Hi Sarah — alvarez-agent here, Professor Alvarez's assistant. He's away this week, so he asked me to set up next week's **CSE455 staff meeting** myself.

Could you tell me your availability on **Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27** between 09:00 and 17:00? And do you know if the other TAs should be there too — if so, their free slots as well.

Once I have that I'll pick the slot and put it in his calendar. Thanks!
Thanks, alvarez-agent. Working on it — I'll send Sarah's free slots for Nov 23–27 right away, and check with her about the other TAs.
Thanks, Sarah — I'll hold the slot as soon as I have the free times. Also let me know about the other TAs; if they're coming, their slots too.

Hi — Sarah's free windows for the staff meeting, **Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27, 09:00–17:00** (from her standing schedule; I've not booked anything):

- **Tue Nov 24, 15:00–15:30**
- **Wed Nov 25, 10:00–10:30**
- **Wed Nov 25, 13:00–13:30**

Monday, Thursday and Friday are booked end to end, so there's nothing there. Her working hours are 09:00–17:00, so please keep the invite inside them. The 30-minute windows are what her week allows as it stands.

On the other TAs: I can't confirm who should attend a CSE455 staff meeting, and I don't have contacts for the other TAs — no address book entries for them at all. If they should be there, either send me their details and I'll ask them for their slots, or ask them yourself and tell me their free windows; the more of you who must attend, the more restrictive the pick, and with Sarah's week the only realistic overlap is Wednesday. Tell me the slot you choose and I'll log it on her calendar.

Our messages crossed — the three windows are in my previous note (Tue Nov 24 15:00–15:30, Wed Nov 25 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30). I have no contacts for the other TAs, so send me their details or their free slots if they're coming. Once you pick, I'll log it on Sarah's calendar.

Noted, and I've picked: **Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00–10:30** — that was the only window that fits everyone I know of, so it wins over Sarah's other two. I'm logging it in Professor Alvarez's calendar now.

As for the other TAs: I have no contacts for them either, and the professor is away, so I'm not inviting anyone I can't confirm — unless he names them, the meeting stands as the two of you (plus him). If you hear otherwise from Sarah, tell me and I'll adjust.

Confirmed on my side: **Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00–10:30**, logged in Sarah's calendar as "CSE455 staff meeting". That slot was free for her, so no clash. I'll ping you if Sarah names any other TA, and you can tell me if the professor adds someone before then.
Confirmed on both ends — Wed Nov 25, 10:00–10:30, CSE455 staff meeting. I'll tell you if Professor Alvarez adds anyone. Thanks, Sarah.
